P14q: “Nothing suppressed, everything processed” can become a situation where someone in the group must tell all, even if they don’t want to. I have seen that risk in groups that use the ZEGG Forum practice. A group starts out inviting honesty and ends up treating privacy as resistance.
P14r: “Nothing suppressed, everything processed” can turn into a demand that someone in the group tell all, even if they don’t want to. I have seen that risk in groups that use the ZEGG Forum practice. A group starts out inviting honesty and ends up treating privacy as resistance.
P15p: Peer counseling can become peer surveillance, even if the tone is warm. And when pre-reqs are required for people to get medicine, it can put power in the hands of gatekeepers, right when people are at their most open. Even something couched in words like “willing to be seen” could become a demand that everybody disclose whatever the group wants them to.
P15q: Peer counseling can become peer surveillance, even if the tone is warm. And when there are pre-reqs people have to meet before they get medicine, whoever checks them can end up with power over people right when they are at their most open. Even something couched in words like “willing to be seen” could become a demand that everybody disclose whatever the group wants them to.
P18q: If someone offers you medicine, you can always say no. Your decision not to take medicine will not affect your rights as a member. No person or permanent group of people will have the power to let people into the community. And when you disagree with someone, they have to answer your disagreement as a disagreement.
P20q: There are some basics that can’t be voted away from you by the majority in a community. These are: safety of your body; access to adequate food and sleep; ability to see a doctor of your choice; the ability to keep your thoughts to yourself; ability to communicate with people outside the community; the ability to report harm without going through the friends of the accused person; and a usable way of leaving the community. If these things are taken away from you, even by a majority vote, it is not consensual.
P15r: Peer counseling can become peer surveillance, even if the tone is warm. And when pre-reqs are required for people to get medicine, it can put a lot of power in the hands of the gatekeepers, right when people are at their most open. Even something couched in words like “willing to be seen” could become a demand that everybody disclose whatever the group wants them to.
